Dream 2026-11-22 linked 5 vignettes from 5 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-24 · touches · "we may need to bring back federation to allow for essays to live in a different repo" (The coming week: linking essays to problems, claims and remedies (2026-10-24))
- 2026-10-30 · retells · "My essay might be able to say... this links to that record in that repo." (Vignette 2026-10-30: the address is core, a citation across repositories may need a mirror)
- 2026-11-05 · retells · "If we are able to manage a repo just for transcripts - and it's addressable it would probably be better. MuSrs is already big" (A repo just for transcripts, addressable, because muSrs is already big (2026-11-05))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "federated, fractal, long term memory" (Vignette 2026-11-06: multi-user, federated, fractal, long-term memory is an important part of the future)
- 2026-11-22 · touches · "We can now look at cross referenced repos... Do we start to use that capability?" (Vignette 2026-11-22: SRS must work well for humans and agents; where do their needs differ and conflict)
